title: Meta tightens grip on AI glasses as China's market stays fragmented
title_zh: Meta一家独大，中国AI眼镜市场却还在内耗

image.credit: Photo by Julio Lopez on Unsplash
image.author: Julio Lopez

lead: Meta now controls more than 80% of the global AI glasses market, yet no single Chinese brand can claim even a fifth of its home turf. As shipments at home fall for the first time, Chinese makers are discovering that comfort and fit matter more than flashy features.
lead_zh: Meta现在拿下了全球AI眼镜市场八成以上的份额，可在中国本土，没有一家品牌能占到五分之一。随着国内出货量首次下滑，中国厂商开始意识到，戴着舒不舒服，比花哨功能更重要。
preview: During this year's Double 11 shopping festival, RayNeo and Alibaba's Quark both claimed first place, the former atop JD.com's smart glasses
preview_zh: 今年双11，雷鸟和阿里旗下的夸克都宣称自己拿了第一：前者登上京东智能眼镜与XR设备品牌榜榜首，后者凭S1机型领跑XR热卖榜。但目前没有哪家中国厂商占据绝对优势。Omdia数据显示，2026年上半年，阿里、影目和小米的份额分别为17.4%、14.6%和14.0%，三家合计还不到一半
paragraphs: During this year's Double 11 shopping festival, RayNeo and Alibaba's Quark both claimed first place, the former atop JD.com's smart glasses and XR brand rankings, the latter leading the XR sales chart with its S1 model. Yet no Chinese manufacturer enjoys a decisive edge: in the first half of 2026, Alibaba, INMO and Xiaomi held 17.4%, 14.6% and 14.0% respectively, together less than half the market, according to Omdia.

Globally, the picture is starkly different. Meta shipped 3.4 million pairs in the same period, commanding 81.3% of worldwide share, while runner-up Even Realities managed just 102,000 — a gap of more than thirtyfold. Much of that dominance rests on Meta's partnership with EssilorLuxottica, whose Ray-Ban and Oakley brands, lens manufacturing and retail network let Meta sell glasses that look ordinary and prioritise photography, audio and AI interaction over complex displays.

Chinese players, by contrast, are hedging across divergent product paths. Xiaomi has followed Meta's screenless route, Alibaba is positioning its Quark glasses as a gateway to services such as Amap and Alipay, and specialists like RayNeo and Rokid are betting on waveguide displays. China already accounts for 45% of global shipments of display-equipped AR and AI glasses, but which form factor will win over mainstream consumers remains unresolved.

Momentum at home is faltering. China's smart glasses shipments fell 8% year on year in the second quarter of 2026, the first decline, dragged down by audio and camera glasses, which dropped 35.4%, even as AR devices surged. IDC attributes the slump partly to ageing flagship products and partly to homogenised offerings that deter upgrades; RayNeo's CEO admitted that of over 200 AI features launched in 2025, fewer than 6% saw sustained use.
Fit is the other hurdle. Return rates on some online channels reach 30%, and up to 70% for individual products, since weight, nose pads and prescription lenses all shape the experience.
paragraphs_zh: 今年双11，雷鸟和阿里旗下的夸克都宣称自己拿了第一：前者登上京东智能眼镜与XR设备品牌榜榜首，后者凭S1机型领跑XR热卖榜。但目前没有哪家中国厂商占据绝对优势。Omdia数据显示，2026年上半年，阿里、影目和小米的份额分别为17.4%、14.6%和14.0%，三家合计还不到一半。
全球市场的格局则截然不同。同期Meta出货340万副，拿下全球81.3%的份额，排名第二的Even Realities只有10.2万副，差距超过30倍。这种统治力很大程度上靠的是与依视路陆逊梯卡的合作：雷朋、欧克利等成熟品牌、镜片制造和零售网络，让Meta能卖出外观普通的眼镜，并把拍照、音频和AI交互放在复杂显示之前。
相比之下，中国厂商在不同产品路线上分散下注。小米走的是和Meta相近的无屏路线，阿里想把夸克眼镜做成高德、支付宝等服务的入口，雷鸟、Rokid等专业厂商则押注光波导显示。中国已占全球带显示AR与AI眼镜出货量的45%，但哪种形态能赢得主流消费者，目前仍无定论。
国内的增长势头正在减弱。2026年第二季度，中国智能眼镜出货量同比下降8%，首次出现负增长，其中音频及拍摄眼镜大跌35.4%，AR设备却在增长。IDC认为，这一方面是部分头部产品进入生命周期末期，另一方面是同质化严重，削弱了换新意愿；雷鸟CEO也坦言，2025年上线的200多项AI功能中，长期使用率不到6%。
佩戴体验是另一道坎。部分线上渠道退货率高达30%，个别产品甚至达到70%，因为重量、鼻托和近视配镜都会影响体验。小米与明月镜片及400多家眼镜门店合作提供验光配镜，这一模式降低了投诉率，也抬高了镜片价格。对2025年净亏损4.56亿元的XREAL这类创业公司来说，维持这样的投入远比Meta困难。
